svg.aria-label: How FastPatch runs inside Kaseya VSA: 1. Schedule: A signed procedure runs for one machine group at a time; 2. Run on the agent: Five checks, then the approved fix; 3. Result line: Status · cause · action per machine; 4. Branch and log: Kaseya routes each result and keeps the logs; 5. Verify: After your restart window: the update really landed
